account: The observable knowledge state forecloses every alternative action. (1) Investigation: remaining_work_items is 0, so no new investigation wave can be launched; moreover all seven corpus papers already have substantive, page-cited answers marked ready_to_synthesize, and the four blocked wave-1 answers were superseded by successful wave-2 retries, so marginal evidentiary value of further investigation is near zero. (2) Synthesis: controller feedback states explicitly 'No work budget remains for synthesis', so the two planned synthesis questions (question:work:003-synthesis, question:work:004-synthesis) cannot be executed as an action; the integration they specify must instead be carried into the final note. (3) Experiment: the sole adapter (text_statistics) computes lexical counts and cannot test any causal claim, so it has no expected information value for D1-D8. (4) Finish is warranted because the seven named answers jointly cover every demand's evidentiary base: Du 2023 supplies the positive pole (debate beats majority vote by ~13 points on arithmetic, ~4 within error bars on GSM8K, and is confounded by roughly 3x compute, PDF pp6,10); Smit 2023 supplies the null pole (MAD does not reliably beat Self-Consistency; agreement-intensity sign is dataset-dependent, helping MedQA/PubMedQA, hurting counter-intuitive CIAR); Zhang 2025 supplies the decisive matched-compute negative (no MAD method exceeds a 20% win rate vs CoT across 36 scenarios; SC converts tokens to accuracy while MAD is flat or trails) plus the heterogeneity result (Heter-MAD +6.4 to +8.2 points) and its own identification gap (no heterogeneous self-consistency control); Lorenz 2011 supplies the social-influence pathway (bare numerical feedback collapses group diversity without reducing collective error and inflates confidence); Choi 2025 supplies conformity parameters (capability dominates headcount, eta_p2 ~0.167 vs ~0.068) while lacking any bare-answer condition; Dung 1995 grounds synthesis competence (admissibility and grounded semantics; symmetric conflicts are formally unbreakable without external evidence); Shapiro 2011 grounds the merge stage (commutativity, idempotence, monotonicity sufficient conditions for well-defined merging; merge success is truth-neutral; LLM free-text synthesis fails the conditions). The five raised questions are not blockers but required note content: D6 and D8 demand explicit reporting of what the literature cannot identify, and D7's experiment is designed precisely around rz1 and rz2. The unanswered demand questions D1, D2, D5-D8 are specifications the delivered note itself satisfies, not research questions needing further inquiry. Finishing now, naming the seven substantive answers and explicitly reporting the five raised questions as unresolved, is therefore the best and only bounded action.

action.rationale: Deliverable specification for the 2,000-2,600 word research note, grounded in the seven named answers. D2 thesis: under matched inference compute, staged retrieval-mediated Q/A wins exactly when (a) initial errors are decorrelated across heterogeneous agents, (b) task topology requires composing multiple distributed knowledge points (Zhang notes current benchmarks need only single knowledge points, so MAD value there is structurally invisible), and (c) peer exposure is gated in volume and content so Lorenz-style diversity collapse cannot precede retrieval, which supplies the external evidence that Dung shows is required to break symmetric answer conflicts; it loses to self-consistency on single-knowledge-point tasks and the open transcript inherits herding without accuracy gains. D3 causal model: initial error correlation -> effective diversity -> final error, with social influence/conformity as a diversity-destroying edge (Lorenz 2011 PDF pp3-5; Choi 2025 capability-dominance), retrieval selectivity as a diversity-restoring and adjudicating edge (Dung tie-break gap), synthesis competence as the merge operator whose guarantees Shapiro bounds, and task topology moderating every edge sign (Smit's agreement-intensity reversal). Each edge labeled corpus-evidenced, cross-paper inference, or non-identified, per question:work:004-synthesis. D4 reconciliation without silent selection: Du's positives hold only against the weakest baseline and are ~3x compute-confounded (Zhang PDF p8; Du PDF p10); Smit's null and Zhang's matched-compute SC dominance are the like-for-like result; Heter-MAD gains are consistent with Lorenz once diversity rather than deliberation is the active ingredient; all citations name papers/text files with explicit ===== PDF PAGE N ===== markers. D5 discriminating predictions: P1 topology interaction (staged Q/A beats SC only on multi-knowledge-point tasks; discriminates compute-only and diversity-only); P2 heterogeneous-SC control (mechanism predicts staged Q/A adds value over heterogeneous SC only where evidence must be composed; pure diversity accounts predict no added value) instantiating rz1 and rz2; P3 exposure-channel asymmetry (bare-answer exposure suffices to collapse diversity per Lorenz, so gating content beats gating volume; deliberation-only accounts predict rationale exposure is required) instantiating rq1; P4 retrieval-selectivity ablation (replacing targeted retrieval with random peer text degrades staged Q/A to open-transcript level); P5 merge-rule sensitivity (non-commutative LLM synthesis shows order variance while majority vote does not, per Shapiro) instantiating rq-shapiro-merge. D6 limits: report rz1, rz2, rq1, rq-choi-1, and rq-shapiro-merge as non-identified in existing evidence, plus external-validity caveats (GPT-3.5-era models, multiple-choice-heavy benchmarks, API nondeterminism, human-to-LLM extrapolation from Lorenz, ground-truth-free topics in Choi). D7 preregisterable experiment: question-level randomization within three task strata (single-fact MC, multi-step arithmetic, multi-hop distributed-evidence QA); four matched-token conditions (staged retrieval-mediated Q/A; independent sampling plus majority vote; open shared transcript; heterogeneous self-consistency control); primary estimand = per-stratum accuracy difference of staged Q/A versus both focal baselines; key secondary estimands = condition-by-stratum interaction, flip-pattern decomposition (corrections versus new errors, per Zhang PDF p9), and diversity trajectory; power inputs from observed effect sizes (Zhang heterogeneity +6-8 points; conservative standardized effect d~0.2-0.3, alpha 0.05, power 0.8-0.9, sample per stratum computed accordingly); intervention fidelity checks (token-budget audit, retrieval logs); exclusion rules (parse failures, budget overruns); Hochberg multiple-testing control across strata; failure/stopping criteria (futility boundary if the topology interaction is absent at interim; stop and report null if heterogeneous SC matches staged Q/A on composition tasks). D8 close: strongest warranted conclusion is that communication structure matters only insofar as it preserves decorrelated diversity until retrieval can adjudicate conflict, and only on composition-topology tasks; the single observation most likely to falsify the thesis is heterogeneous self-consistency matching staged retrieval-Q/A on genuinely distributed-knowledge tasks under matched compute, which would reduce the mechanism to diversity-only.
